dossier.scp_unleashed.323.title: Wendigo Skull
dossier.scp_unleashed.323.caption: SCP-323 where it was found, lying in the leaf litter with its antlers splayed.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-323 is to be kept in a storage locker with a solid door, shut at all times. The locker is never to be fitted with a glass front.
Staff are not to look at SCP-323 directly, and are not to carry it by hand. %rApproved handling procedures are held by the containment lead.%r
**No one is to put SCP-323 on. No one who has worn it has been recovered whole.**
If SCP-323 is found loose, clear the area and break line of sight. Any SCP-323-1 instance is to be avoided rather than engaged, and staff are to stay indoors until it is gone.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-323 is the skull of a large deer, bleached and weathered, crowned with heavy branching antlers. Its eye sockets are unusually large and deep.
Anyone who can see SCP-323 is drawn toward it. Subjects who carry it soon find it on their own head.

Once worn, SCP-323 fuses to the wearer. Within seconds the wearer is replaced by SCP-323-1: a gaunt figure close to three metres tall, with long dark limbs, ragged fur over the shoulders and chest, and SCP-323 in place of a face.
SCP-323-1 hunts people. Wearers report being present throughout, seeing everything, and unable to act.
When SCP-323-1 has fed, the wearer reappears where it stood, carrying a pair of antlers. %rThe change is not permanent in either direction.%r

page.title: Addendum 323-1: Incident Log
text: Incident 323-02: a D-class subject sent to fetch SCP-323 from a corridor put it on before the team could stop him. Two staff were lost before he was found, unhurt, at the end of the corridor.
Incident 323-04: a researcher with antlers was cleared after a medical review and sent home. She did not report to work the next morning.
Incident 323-07: a security team brought down an SCP-323-1 instance in the east wing. The wearer did not survive. SCP-323 was recovered from the floor beside the body.
Incident 323-09: a guard carried SCP-323 the length of Site storage and back without incident. The transfer was logged at midday.

page.title: Addendum 323-2: Appearance
page.text: SCP-323 has no recovery record. It was first found lying in the open near a reader of this file, some minutes after the reading. It has come the same way each time since, and no recovery team has ever seen it arrive. %rDo not read this file alone.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp323.1: SCP-323, the Wendigo Skull: a weathered deer skull under heavy antlers. Some time after its file is read, it turns up on the ground near the reader.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp323.2: Anyone who can see it is drawn toward it, and it does not stay in a pack for long. Sooner or later it ends up on someone's head. It seems quieter in daylight.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp323.3: Worn, it does not come off. The wearer is replaced by SCP-323-1, a tall, starved thing that hunts people, and the wearer can only watch through its eyes.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp323.4: Once it has fed, the wearer comes back, marked. It does not stay gone. It is worst after dark.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp323.5: Whatever kills SCP-323-1 kills its wearer too, and the skull is left behind. Contain it in a storage locker behind a solid, shut door.
SCP-323-1, the hunting form of SCP-323: a gaunt, long-limbed thing in ragged fur, wearing the Wendigo Skull. Keter-class. Fast, and it hunts the nearest person it can see.
It never spawns naturally. Operators can use /scp_unleashed scp323 with place, transform, retract, status or clear.
